description: This Java class defines an abstract unmodifiable map for clustering strategies related to JSON-serializable types within the Eclipse Ditto project, including loading these strategies via an Akka actor system configuration.

classes.name: MappingStrategies
classes.description: An abstract class representing an unmodifiable mapping of string keys to JsonParsable<Jsonifiable<?>> strategies, with methods for configuration-based loading and retrieval of strategies.

methods.name: MappingStrategies
methods.description: Constructor that creates a new MappingStrategies instance with the provided strategies map, ensuring it is non-null.

methods.name: loadMappingStrategies
methods.description: Static method to load and instantiate a MappingStrategies object based on the ActorSystem's configuration.

methods.name: getMappingStrategy
methods.description: Retrieves an optional mapping strategy associated with a given key.

methods.name: entrySet
methods.description: Returns the set of entries (key-value pairs) in the strategies map.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides the default equals method to compare strategies based on their internal map.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides the default hashCode method to generate a hash based on strategies.
